fa_settings_change_after_restart: ^ This setting will take effect after restarting the client ^
fa_disable_ai_desc: Hide the AI text editor and post summaries
fa_disable_auto_download_desc: Disable auto-download for media, stickers, and animations
fa_disable_animated_avatars_desc: Disable looping animations for profile pictures
fa_disable_premium_animation_desc: Disable special animations and effects for Premium users
fa_show_start_token_desc: Show start parameter tokens when opening bots
fa_show_peer_ids_desc: Show IDs in user, group, and channel profiles
fa_show_dc_ids: Show DC IDs in label of peer ids
fa_show_dc_ids_desc: Show datacenter ID next to peer IDs in profiles
fa_id_in_botapi_type_desc: Show IDs in Bot API format instead of internal format
fa_show_registration_date_desc: Show registration date in user profiles
fa_hide_phone_number_desc: Hide phone numbers in settings and profiles
fa_screenshot_mode_desc: Randomize names, avatars, and text for privacy in screenshots
fa_hide_stories_desc: Hide stories from the chat list
fa_local_tg_premium_desc: Enable visual Premium features locally without a subscription
fa_parse_markdown_hyperlink_desc: Convert [text](URL) syntax into clickable links when sending
fa_disable_custom_chat_background: β Hide custom background of chat
fa_disable_custom_chat_background_desc: Ignore custom chat backgrounds set by users or channels
fa_hide_open_webapp_button_chatlist_desc: Hide Web App buttons in the chat list
fa_hide_all_chats_folder_desc: Hide the 'All Chats' tab in the folder list
fa_show_discuss_button_desc: Add a button in channels to jump to their discussion group
fa_show_message_details_desc: Show detailed metadata and info for messages
fa_add_comma_after_mention_desc: Add a comma after mentioning a username
fa_unlimited_pinned_chats_desc: Pin up to 100 chats locally on this device
fa_unlimited_chat_folders_desc: Create up to 100 folders locally on this device
fa_delete_for_everyone: Checkmark "Delete for everyone" enabled by default
fa_delete_for_everyone_desc: Pre-select "Delete for everyone" when deleting messages
fa_last_seen_timestamp: Show full timestamp after 1 hour offline
fa_last_seen_timestamp_desc: Show exact date and time instead of relative hours when offline over 1 hour
fa_show_forwarded_date_in_title: Show date of forwarded messages in the title
fa_show_forwarded_date_in_title_desc: Show original date and time in forwarded message headers
fa_disable_greeting_sticker_desc: Hide greeting stickers and intro prompts in new private chats
fa_use_default_rounding_desc: Reset avatar corner rounding to default
fa_force_snow_desc: Enable the winter snow effect year-round
fa_logs_dir: Logs are saved in the DebugLogs folder next to FAgram
fa_setting_need_restart: FAgram will restart to apply this setting
fa_hide_blocked_user_messages_desc: Hide messages from blocked users behind spoilers and disable auto-download
fa_status_dot_desc: Show status dots on avatars: green for online, grey for offline, and black for deleted or blocked users.
fa_context_menu_reply_in_private_desc: Add an option to reply to the sender in a private chat
fa_context_menu_desc: Configure quick action shortcuts in message context menus
fa_context_menu_forward_submenu_desc: Show quick forward options (Copy, Saved) in the context menu
fa_shortcut_customization_desc: Customize size and spacing of context menu shortcut buttons
fa_use_tdesktop_themes_desc: Use classic Telegram Desktop themes (Day Blue/Night) instead of Material You
fa_use_material_icon_pack_desc: Replace default icons with Material Icons. Requires restart.
fa_import_config_confirm: Do you want to apply settings from this file? Your current settings will be replaced.
fa_import_config_restart: Settings applied successfully. Restart now to apply all changes?
fa_show_fastshare_in_chats_desc: Show quick share buttons on messages in private chats and groups
